messages:
maya: Heads-up: scheduling a small perf blast for 8.3.0. Window Fri 04:00 PT. Need a short RN blurb for internal announce, pin snippet, canary cadence, and an explicit evacuation checklist. @ruth can you draft RN? @diego ops lead?

ruth: Yep. I'll do 1-line + 2 bullets + rollback. Keep it concise for #all-hands copy.

diego: Ops standby. Proposed canary: 5% (15m) -> 30% (20m) -> 100% gradual. Gates: error-rate, p95 latency, and sampled QA prompts. On failure: abort, pin back to 8.2.9 and disable new-kernel-8 flag.

kai: Small request: add an explicit sampling plan for QA prompts (10 queries covering common short/long prompts). If quality drift > 12% abort.

deploybot: Preflight checks started for release 8.3.0
```
preflight:
- infra: OK
- migrations: NONE
- smoke: 13/13 PASS
- canary hooks: configured
- quotas: OK
```

ruth: Draft RN microcopy:
```
8.3.0 (micro): batching and kernel tuning to reduce short-prompt tail latency (~9%). No API changes. Pin: 8.3.0. Rollback: automatic fallback to 8.2.9 and disable `new-kernel-8` + telemetry off if canary gates fail.
```

diego: Rollback thresholds (ops):
- error-rate >= 1.5x baseline sustained for 5m OR
- p95 latency >= 2x baseline sustained for 5m OR
- QA sample regression > 12%
Actions on abort:
1) deployctl abort --release 63123
2) deployctl rollback --service inference --version 8.2.9
3) curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"new-kernel-8","state":"off"}'
4) turn telemetry off for the kernel path

maya: Add manifest pin reminder: set `pin_version: "8.3.0"` and run `deployctl dry-run --release 63123` by 03:30 PT.

kai: I'll prepare the 10 QA prompts and attach them. Diego will monitor first 45m; escalate to @maya and @ruth if thresholds hit.

ruth: I'll post the RN here and pin it to the channel by EOD, include the exec one-liner: "Perf micro-update; canary-first; minimal customer exposure."

deploybot: Reminder: add `pin_version: "8.3.0"` to release manifest before 03:30 PT on rollout day.

diego: All good from ops. Final sign-off when RN is posted.

maya: Thanks all 44d. Closing thread; will wait for RN post for final sign-off.
